judged_text: save()'s only in-flight guard is cantSave's host.isSaving — a property Discourse's custom RestModel never defines — so nothing actually prevents concurrent invocations of save(). Pressing Enter in the host input and then clicking the check button (or double-clicking) issues two POSTs before either resolves; the server has no uniqueness validation on EmbeddableHost.host, so both succeed and two identical rows are silently created, visible only after the next page load.
